newsitem.title: FRANCE: Borotra says supporting Renault's head.
newsitem.headline: Borotra says supporting Renault's head.

text.p: French industry minister Franck Borotra said he was supporting embattled Renault chairman Louis Schweitzer but said the chairman must assume responsibility for the restructuring plan of the car company.
"The chairman of Renault takes responsibility for his decision," Borotra told Europe 1 radio. "I am not abandoning Schweitzer nor the Renault company," he said.
Borotra also said that the decision to close the Belgian Vilvoorde assembly plant, near Brussels, was needed to reduce costs and respond to competition.
"Restructurings cannot be avoided," he said, adding "even Renault can die".
Borotra said that the French and Belgian authorities had been told of the company's plan to close the Vilvoorde plant in the days before the official announcement was made.
